annotations.title: Demo subjects for testing the API

description: Real, read-only demo subjects for testing the ASPERN API, each discovered now from the live list it belongs to (an address among the profiled depositors, a curator with flows, a depositor and a vault it holds, a platform id for the vault filter), with the GET that answers 200 for it, a negative GET and the documented 404 code it must answer, and every documented 404 code per operation. A subject that could not be discovered is not_available, and a check that depends on it is not assessed, never passed. A benchmark run is private to the key that starts it, so it is described as the steps to make one. Free; no key needed.
name: api_test_fixtures

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

available.description: How many subjects were discovered now.

fixtures.description: id, operation, relation, state (available | not_available | requires_own_key), positive {url, expect}, negative {url, expect, code}, discoveredFrom, why.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

rules.description: How to use the subjects: read-only, not assessed when missing, a documented 404 is the API working.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Demo subjects for testing the API
